title: One Day Mikumi Safari
notes: Includes: hotel pickup & return; full-day game drive in Mikumi National Park; professional driver/guide; park entrance fees; lunch & bottled water; all government taxes.
Day plan: Early hotel pick-up. Drive to Mikumi National Park. Full-day game drive with picnic lunch. Late afternoon return and drop-off at your hotel.

title: 2 Days / 1 Night — Tarangire + Ngorongoro
notes: Includes: hotel pickup & return; game drives in Tarangire and Ngorongoro; overnight accommodation; meals as arranged; park entrance fees; professional driver/guide; bottled water; all government taxes.
Day 1: Hotel pick-up. Game drive in Tarangire National Park. Picnic lunch. Continue to overnight lodge near the crater highlands. Dinner and overnight.
Day 2: Early descent into Ngorongoro Crater for a full crater-floor game drive. Lunch. Return transfer and drop-off at your hotel.

title: 2 Days / 1 Night — Selous / Nyerere National Park
booking_item: 2 Days 1 Night Selous / Nyerere National Park
notes: Includes: return flights Zanzibar–Selous; airport transfers in Zanzibar; accommodation; all meals; park entrance fees; professional driver/guide; lunch & bottled water; all government taxes.

Day 1: Early morning hotel pick-up + transfer to Zanzibar Airport. Domestic flight to Selous G.R. / Nyerere National Park. Game drive in the largest national park in Africa. Mid-morning coffee/tea break. Picnic hamper with hot lunch. End of game drive, dinner and overnight at Selous Safari Lodge or Africa Safari Lodge.
Day 2: Early morning bush walk. Sunrise boat cruise. Breakfast at the lodge. After check-out, Maasai village visit. Lunch. Flight back to Zanzibar Airport + transfer to your hotel.
